identity_features.body: black rounded tall rectangular monster body
identity_features.eye_pattern: red spiral embedded in recessed black lenses
identity_features.belly_pattern: large red spiral shallow surface relief

tsa_locks.eye_depth_rule: Eyes must be embedded into real socket recesses; never sticker-like discs floating on the front surface.
tsa_locks.arm_anatomy_rule: Every arm preserves shoulder, upper arm, elbow, forearm, wrist, palm and simplified digits.
tsa_locks.leg_anatomy_rule: Every leg preserves hip/thigh, knee, calf, ankle, foot and toe direction even when proportions are compact.
tsa_locks.surface_detail_rule: Spiral details must sit as shallow surface-following relief, not free-floating ornaments.
tsa_locks.static_gate: No rig or animation until canonical form, anatomy and all-angle consistency are approved.
